title: GPT Image 2.6 + GPT Astra 6.2
author: FilipeDM
selftext:
I asked Astra 6.2 to turn the images and sprites I created with GPT Image 2.6 into a playable game, and here's the result!

The game uses a 2.5D perspective, with no actual 3D elements. Everything you see is made entirely from 2D images and sprites.

So far, I've only added the main character and the environment. There are no enemies yet, but this is just the beginning!
